description: Client-side script for 'Batch' doctype in ERPNext, managing batch details, stock levels, and related actions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up query for item field in Batch form.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes form, adds 'View Ledger' button, and triggers dashboard creation.

methods.name: item
methods.description: Fetches item expiry info and updates expiry date accordingly.

methods.name: make_dashboard
methods.description: Creates a dashboard showing stock levels and provides move/split actions.
